items.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Our band and Count Basie. As a matter of fact our band and Count Basie, maybe Lionel Hampton, were the only bands that played the big hotels.

ctx.x: I understand you were singing on the radio when a very important announcement was made in 1945?

Well I swore I’d never talk about it because people, you know people may say that — right now — I think about it, the night, and I could tell you, the night that World War II ended. It was ABC. And there was a lot of things happening. We were in the Hotel Lincoln. As you know, the Hotel Lincoln was the only one in New York that used black bands. Our band and Count Basie.
